references.text: A similar gold rim (zer) was made around the ark of the covenant, showing the decorative frame used on sacred furniture in the tabernacle.
The previous verse describes the gold rim around the table itself, while verse 25 describes the rim around the ledge (misgereth).
The incense altar also had a gold rim around it, reflecting the consistent design pattern for sacred furniture in the tabernacle.
This verse describes the actual construction of the ledge and gold rim on the table of showbread, fulfilling the instructions given in 25:25.
The description of the rims and ledges on the basins in Solomon's temple shows similar decorative elements to those on the tabernacle furniture.
